analyze.title: Analyze a Warcraft Logs report
analyze.subtitle: Paste a WCL link or report code. We'll cache the report and let you ask the AI for an analysis per fight and player.

analyze.headline: Headline

topLogs.title: Top logs

admin.title: Administration
admin.wowDataHelp: Spell, item and encounter names downloaded from wago.tools. Auto-refreshed weekly when a new game build appears.
admin.topLogsToolsHelp: Top logs are refreshed weekly by the worker. Use this panel to add a new boss or force an early refresh of one already cached.
admin.topLogsSeedQueued: Queued — refresh runs in the background for all specs.
admin.topLogsRefreshOne: Refresh all metrics for this boss

profile.title: Your profile
profile.wclSectionHelp: Connecting your WCL account lets the analyzer read your private and unlisted reports. Without it, only logs you've published publicly on warcraftlogs.com can be analysed.
